title.zh: 【Robinhood 将推出加密永续合约、美股周末交易及 AI Agents】
title.en: 【Robinhood 将推出加密永续合约、美股周末交易及 AI Agents】

current_state.zh: At its HOOD Summit, Robinhood announced crypto perpetual futures with up to 10x leverage for eligible US users via Robinhood Derivatives and Bitstamp, weekend trading of select US stocks and ETFs through the Bruce ATS alternative trading system, and AI agents that can analyze markets and place trades using OpenAI or Anthropic models.
